fail_to_pass: a final full page has no cursor and there is no empty page after it
a limit equal to the number of items returns everything with no cursor
the default limit is 10 and the largest is 100
a limit that is not a positive integer is refused before the cursor is looked at
the cursor is the id of the last item shown, so deleting items does not skip anything
items added before the cursor do not repeat anything
a cursor to an id that no longer exists still works
a cursor is base64url of {"id":n} without padding
a bad cursor is an invalid cursor error, from page and from decodeCursor
pass_to_pass: no items gives an empty page and no cursor
undefined and null cursors mean the first page
walking every page returns every item once
the first page holds the first items and offers a cursor
following the cursor reaches the next page
a short last page has no cursor
